title: Observability snapshot walkthrough: latency, token-cost, and trace views (asset pack)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Produce a focused asset pack of annotated screenshots and SVGs for the Observability quickstart and onboarding flow. Deliverables will include a set of canonical dashboard snapshots (latency distribution, p50/p95 timelines, cost-per-token breakdown by model/route) and a trace view walkthrough that highlights root-cause signals for slow requests. Assets must be annotated for docs and in-product tour usage, supplied in light/dark theme variants, and sized for both desktop and mobile quickstart guides.
acceptance_criteria: One canonical latency snapshot with layered annotation (p50/p95 lines, percentiles heatmap) exported in 3 sizes: desktop (1440px), tablet (768px), mobile (375px)
Cost-per-token waterfall visualization exported as SVG and PNG, annotated with tooltip callouts for caching/batching impact
Tracing waterfall screenshot representing a tail-latency incident with overlays: service calls, KV cache hit/miss, model variant fallback
All assets uploaded to the Observability Figma file with a documented naming convention and a short handoff doc in Drive
In-product copy for tooltip/annotation reviewed by PM and Eng and approved in comments
